The Farm Market is full of local goods -- enough to do a complete grocery shop, with fresh produce, dairy, meats and poultry, breads from local artisans, honeys and syrups, and pastas and grains. We offer the opportunity to pick flowers, herbs and other farm fresh items directly from our fields, too!
Spring Season, Summer Season, Fall Season, Thanksgiving Season

It is a bountiful season with local produce from our farms, as well as other local growers! You can also find local dairy, meats, breads, and local grocery items, from pastas to hot pepper sauces. Fresh cut bouquets, and other gift items, too. Customers are welcome to purchase a \"you pick\" option where you can cut your own flowers, herbs and veggies from our fields, located on the property. Visit farm animals, see the splendor of our farm, or grab a cold ice cream from our freezer to eat at one of our picnic benches!
